name: Red Hat Product Security CSAF 2.0 advisories and VEX (security.access.redhat.com)
operator: Red Hat, Inc. (Red Hat Product Security)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms and a privacy policy; CSAF trusted provider (A8 BR2); P354: 'Tier refers to the Red Hat VEX adapter' (trusted).

reliability.justification: Vendor advisories (RHSA) and per-CVE VEX statements about Red Hat products: the authoritative source for their fix and not-affected status.

Synced out of band into the local CSAF index, newest first within a lookback window (changes.csv has ~32,700 rows and thousands of daily changes): <= 2,000 documents per sync.

csaf_vex.title: Red Hat CSAF VEX per CVE: /data/csaf/v2/vex/{year}/cve-{year}-{n}.json (csaf_redhat_vex)

csaf_vex.notes: P354 cond 3: fetched only per in-scope CVE (analyst seeds and has_vuln CVEs, CVE fan-out rule P183); sends the CVE id (disclosure third_party). 404 text/html 'Page not found.' = no VEX for that CVE. Never bulk-synced (vex/changes.csv: ~78,000 rows).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G08-1 (P354). Canonical advisory pages (access.redhat.com/errata, /security/cve) are links only.
